summary: This clinical trial is testing different types of metformin tablets in adults who have both type 2 diabetes (a condition causing high blood sugar) and coronary heart disease (narrowed heart blood vessels). The study is currently Recruiting 356 participants, sponsored by the China National Center for Cardiovascular Diseases. It is a Phase 4 study that compares a new slow-release metformin medicine against standard metformin tablets over a 24-week period.

facts.sponsor: China National Center for Cardiovascular Diseases
